title: Kaizena Flow compared with WooCommerce

seo.title: Kaizena Flow vs WooCommerce: compared for EU shops
seo.description: How Kaizena Flow compares with WooCommerce for EU shops: legal rules, hosting, extensions and AI, checked on WooCommerce's own pages. WordPress can stay.

heroRest: The legal side of EU selling, hosting, updates and an AI that runs the shop come with Flow, and your WordPress site can stay. Here is how it compares with WooCommerce, line by line.

faq.q: Can I move my WooCommerce shop to Flow?
faq.rest: Connect WooCommerce, choose whether to keep WordPress, copy your shop and press Move when you are happy. Products, customers, orders, coupons, reviews and old links come with you.

faq.q: Do I need extensions to get what the Flow column shows?
faq.rest: Everything in the Flow column is part of Flow. Owning several stores starts on the Grow plan.

faq.q: Can I keep my WordPress site?
faq.rest: Move only the shop: your pages and blog stay on WordPress, and your shop moves to shop.yourdomain.com. Our free WordPress plugin can show its products on your pages.

faq.q: Who looks after hosting and updates?
faq.rest: Flow is hosted and updated for you. There is no server to run and nothing to install.
Your store's database and servers are in Dublin, Ireland.

faq.q: Is it safe to let the AI work on its own?
faq.bold: You decide how much it does.
faq.rest: Refunds, emails to your whole list, changes to your staff and your domain always wait for your yes, and every change it makes is in the activity log.
